content: Let's create a model of a toy car. For the body, create a box with size 200x100x100 mm. Subtract a block of size 50x100x50 at an edge for the windshield part. Add four cylindrical wheels, each with a radius of 25 mm and a thickness of 10 mm. Place the wheels so that they are exactly aligned with the four bottom corners of the car body. The wheels should be embedded into the body, forming half-cylinders oriented along the Y-Axis (positive and negative). They should point inward and must not protrude beyond the sides of the car body. | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

{"PythonCode":"# Calculate the positions for the wheels
# The car body dimensions are 200x100x100
# Wheels are placed at the four bottom corners, embedded into the body
# Wheel radius is 25 mm, thickness is 10 mm

# Positions for the wheels (base centers)
# Front left wheel
front_left_x = 25  # Half of the wheel thickness (10 mm) embedded into the body
front_left_y = 0   # Aligned with the edge
front_left_z = 25  # Radius of the wheel

# Front right wheel
front_right_x = 25
front_right_y = 100  # Aligned with the opposite edge
front_right_z = 25

# Rear left wheel
rear_left_x = 200 - 25  # 200 mm length minus half the wheel thickness
rear_left_y = 0
rear_left_z = 25

# Rear right wheel
rear_right_x = 200 - 25
rear_right_y = 100
rear_right_z = 25

# Return the positions
wheel_positions = {
    "front_left": (front_left_x, front_left_y, front_left_z),
    "front_right": (front_left_x, front_right_y, front_left_z),
    "rear_left": (rear_left_x, rear_left_y, rear_left_z),
    "rear_right": (rear_right_x, rear_right_y, rear_left_z)
}
wheel_positions"}
